newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan posts year-high against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan posts year-high against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended up at a year-high of 8.3024 on Monday against the U.S. dollar from 8.3026 last Friday on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, after China's August healthy trade surplus.
It was the sixth trading day in a row that the yuan closed at a year-high but the rise was slower than last Friday, dealers said.
The yuan opened unchanged at 8.3026 and moved in a narrow range between 8.3024 and an intra-day low of 8.3027 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.3021.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3025, traders said.
Dealers said that the yuan continued its uptrend because of China's good trade surplus in August, but the rise was slower than last Friday, with trading dull.
"The yuan was stuck around 8.3025 yuan, with minimal trading beyond that level," said one dealer.
"The yuan has risen for more than one week and is likely to consolidate below 8.30 in the short term," a second dealer said. Traders expect the yuan to try to breach 8.3020 on Tuesday.
The yuan closed up at an intra-day low of 7.5400 from 7.5755 against 100 Japanese yen and down at 1.0736 from 1.0750 against the Hong Kong dollar.
